input_datasets.title: Input datasets
input_datasets.description: Datasets to stage for the command. They are placed in selection order as ./inputs/1, ./inputs/2, and so on, each keeping its own directory structure. Accepts a dataset ID as well as an S3 root.

command.title: Command
command.description: Shell commands to run against the selected datasets. Read from ./inputs/1, ./inputs/2, ... and write anything you want to keep to ./output, which becomes the new dataset. Runs under bash with 'set -euo pipefail'; a non-zero exit marks the run failed but still saves the log.

container.title: Container image
container.description: Any public Docker image that has bash and ps installed. A missing ps fails the task before your command runs, which rules out most '-slim' images. The default carries pixi, so 'pixi exec -c conda-forge -c bioconda --spec TOOL -- TOOL ...' fetches anything you need at run time.

timeout_hours.title: Time limit (hours)
timeout_hours.description: The run is killed after this long. Raise it for long jobs; lower it to fail fast.
